briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3 race intensifies as safety gaps widen in production deployments

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases amid regulatory scrutiny while compute shortages constrain smaller players. Prompt injection attacks surge in multi-agent systems, exposing critical infrastructure risks.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4-preview with 2.1T parameters; Anthropic counters with Claude 4 Opus. DeepSeek-V3 achieves 94% MMLU, pressuring Meta's Llama 4 rollout timeline.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level across CAN bus and BCI applications.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC ramps 2nm AI chips for xAI Colossus cluster; Microsoft announces $50B data center expansion in Texas. NVIDIA Blackwell supply constraints persist into Q4.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent dialect protocols become mandatory for all frontier deployments by 2028?
